description: This source file contains unit tests for the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor component in Swift. It defines a test suite with multiple test cases verifying the preprocessing of markdown content, including image handling, metadata stripping, timestamp removal, and other text transformations.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessorTests
classes.description: A test suite struct that contains various test functions to verify the behavior of ChatMarkdownPreprocessor.

methods.name: extractsDataURLImages
methods.description: Tests extraction of base64-encoded image data URLs from markdown.

methods.name: flattensRemoteMarkdownImagesIntoText
methods.description: Tests flattening remote images into text by replacing images with alt text.

methods.name: usesFallbackTextForUnlabeledRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Verifies fallback text for images without labels.

methods.name: handlesUnicodeBeforeRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Ensures Unicode characters preceding images are preserved correctly.

methods.name: stripsInboundUntrustedContextBlocks
methods.description: Tests removal of inbound untrusted JSON metadata blocks.

methods.name: stripsSingleConversationInfoBlock
methods.description: Checks removal of specific JSON metadata block.

methods.name: stripsAllKnownInboundMetadataSentinels
methods.description: Verifies removal of various known untrusted metadata headers.

methods.name: preservesNonMetadataJsonFence
methods.description: Ensures JSON fences not marked as metadata are preserved.

methods.name: stripsEnvelopeHeadersAndMessageIdHints
methods.description: Removes envelope headers and message ID hints from markdown.

methods.name: stripsTrailingUntrustedContextSuffix
methods.description: Removes untrusted context suffixes from the message.

methods.name: preservesUntrustedContextHeaderWhenItIsUserContent
methods.description: Ensures that meaningful untrusted context is preserved if it appears as user content.
